name: claude-android-engineering
description: Reusable, spec-based Claude Code skills and agents for native Android app development: project setup, Jetpack Compose UI, feature implementation as a flat server-authoritative view layer, permission and notification-channel derivation, QR/barcode scanning, USB (UVC) cameras, localization, test suites and CI wiring, toolchain upgrades, perceived performance, local debugging, and read-only UX, code, security, and release-readiness reviews. Every skill is grounded in a spec under spec/android/. Play-Store release tooling is out of scope.
